title: Right derivation of an ordinary mate square with exact left adjoints
statement: Let C,D,C′,D′ be abelian categories with K-injective resolutions and derived categories in a common universe [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Let F:C→D, K:C′→D′, G:D→D′, H:C→C′, P:C′→C and Q:D′→D be additive functors. Assume G and H are exact, H preserves K-injective complexes, and fix adjunctions H⊣P and G⊣Q. Let e: P;F ≅ K;Q and m:F;G ≅ H;K be ordinary squares with m the inverse mate of e. Fix ed:RP;RF≅RK;RQ satisfying the pasted right-derived unit equation U(P,F);Qh(ed)=Qh(e);U(K,Q). Define β:RF;D(G)≅D(H);RK by inverse exact postcomposition comparison, right derivation of m, K-injective composition comparison, and the exact identification RH≅D(H). Then β.hom is the inverse mate of ed.hom under the exact-left-adjoint derived adjunctions of [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived]. No scheme morphism, pullback composition comparison, or counit equation for the projection adjunctions is in this claim.

proof.text: Prove comparison_unit componentwise by expanding the four comparisons and applying rightDerivedUnique and rightDerivedNatTrans factorization. This is an actual Lean proof: no auxiliary hole is used.
Apply derivedMate_pastedUnit to the comparison and the proved comparison_unit equation. This gives the normalized unit of its forward mate.

Use hm and the inverse law of mateEquiv to identify the ordinary forward mate of m with e. The right adjoint P of exact H preserves K-injectives, so RP;RF is right derived with unit U(P,F). Combine the normalized mate-unit equation with hed and apply rightDerived_ext. The inverse mate law then gives exactMateComparison_eq.
